comparison.objective: Even two wire tips and twist a connector clockwise until snug; candidate removes an existing crimp terminal from a housing.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests wire-tip alignment, capture, and controlled rotational tightening. Candidate tests dual-blade insertion, tang depression, and axial push-then-pull coordination.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires both wires captured at proper depth and a connector in the allowed snug angle range without prohibited reverse/over-torque behavior. Candidate requires selective rear extraction without crimp separation, housing damage, or neighbor release.
comparison.reason: Wire joining by twist-on fastening tests different contact mechanics and motion from housing depinning.
